test_TaskInfra_subclassing: test that subclassing a pydantic model with TaskInfra raises RuntimeError when infra is overridden without overriding the decorated function
test_MapInfra_subclassing: test that subclassing a pydantic model with MapInfra raises RuntimeError when the version is changed in the subclass
test_exclude_from_cache_uid: test that exclude_from_cache_uid on TaskInfra.apply correctly ignores specified fields when computing the cache UID
test_clone_obj: test that TaskInfra.clone_obj creates a deep copy of the config object with updated field values
test_OrderedDict_serialization: test that OrderedDict fields in pydantic models preserve key order through YAML serialization and deserialization with ConfDict
